item.subject: science
item.stem: In a school health check-up in Jaipur, Nurse Meena records the morning body temperatures of four healthy students: Aarav 36.6 °C, Diya 37.0 °C, Kabir 37.4 °C and Sana 36.8 °C. The normal human body temperature is usually taken as 37.0 °C. Which statement about these readings is correct?

options.A: Only Diya is healthy, because a healthy person's temperature must be exactly 37.0 °C.
options.B: All four students can be healthy, because 37.0 °C is an average and small differences above or below it can still be normal.
options.C: Aarav and Sana must be ill, because their temperatures are below 37.0 °C.
options.D: Kabir must be ill, because any reading above 37.0 °C always means fever.
